thread:
maria: Hey, seeing a spike in 500s from model-serving-prod-canary, started ~5m ago. rate ~8% for /v1/generate. not sure if it's the new image rollout.
ajay: works locally for me, how long since the canary started?
maria: deploy-bot posted a canary deploy at 1769999940 (image: registry.redwood/prod/model-server:build-20260315). canary traffic 10%.
deploy-bot: automated: canary rollout started for service=model-server cluster=prod: canary=10% image=registry.redwood/prod/model-server:build-20260315 :rocket:
li: grabbing logs from canary pods now. seeing `segfault` in model runtime at startup in the pod logs. stacktrace points to native op init.
maria: Ugh. customers hitting 503s on /chat too. Incident-bot? can we page oncall?
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created: P-10823 - model-server canary 500s spike. Escalation to eng-oncall.
oncall-rotation: I'm on it, will join. Maria, can you confirm the image digest used by the running pods?
maria: `kubectl get pods -l app=model-server,canary=true -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}'` -> registry.redwood/prod/model-server:build-20260315
ajay: That tag was built by CI last hour. Are we sure the registry digest matches the one we tested? sometimes CI reuses tags.
li: running `gcrctl images describe registry.redwood/prod/model-server:build-20260315 --format='{{.Digest}}'` -> sha256:abcd1234old
maria: our artefact store test image digest (from staging run) is sha256:efgh5678new. They don't match.
ajay: oh no. CI probably reused the tag when a retry build pushed a different image. Duplicate build id with mutable tags. Classic.
li: `regctl manifest get registry.redwood/prod/model-server:build-20260315 | jq '.history[0].v1Compatibility'` shows base layer timestamp 2026-03-01 vs staging test timestamp 2026-03-15.
oncall-rotation: This explains segfault — runtime built against a newer CUDA lib expected in test image. Need rollback canary to previous good digest.
maria: Can we flip feature flag to reduce impact while we roll back? customer-facing chat flag `ff:model-server-canary` controls model selection for tiered customers.
ajay: Flipping flag to disable canary routing for public traffic now: `redwood-ff toggle model-server-canary --off --env=prod`
maria: :thumbsup: flag toggled. telemetry shows immediate drop in user 500s from 8% -> 3% but still some leftover from in-flight requests.
li: Initiating rollback to pinned digest sha256:efgh5678new on canary pods: `kubectl set image deploy/model-server model-server=registry.redwood/prod/model-server@sha256:efgh5678new --record`
deploy-bot: rollout started for deploy/model-server to image registry.redwood/prod/model-server@sha256:efgh5678new
oncall-rotation: Monitoring. If rollout fails, we'll kill the canary entirely.
maria: Also opening a CI ticket: looks like our pipeline allows tag reuse on retry without immutability enforcement. That's the root cause.
ajay: Agreed. For immediate mitigations: 1) enforce immutable tags / use digest promotion, 2) fail CI if tag already exists, 3) add registry webhook to reject mutable pushes.
li: rollback completed on canary, pods now show image digest efgh5678new and logs no segfaults so far. metrics back to baseline.
incident-bot: Incident P-10823 acknowledged. Status: mitigated, customer impact reduced.
oncall-rotation: I'll leave a postmortem stub: /incidents/P-10823/ci-duplicate-tag-cascade. Assigning to ajay for CI fix and maria for postmortem writeup.
maria: Adding immediate action item: add mutation rule to registry, announce to platform team.
ajay: I'll update CI to push with a unique immutable artifact id (use build id + commit sha) and stop reusing the human-friendly tag. Also adding a check: `if tag_exists && !force_push: exit 1`
li: Quick note — we should add a canary guard that checks image digest used in canary against the digest from the CI artifact registry. If mismatch, abort rollout.
oncall-rotation: Good idea. Also ensure runbook updated: include steps to quickly flip ff and rollback by digest.
maria: Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring for residual errors and start the postmortem draft.
ajay: Will follow up with PR for CI changes today.
li: Closing thread when postmortem link is added.
maria: closing in 2h unless anything new pops up. :white_check_mark:
